title: Correct frictional force
description: Essential: The response must state or calculate the horizontal frictional force as 80 N.

title: Correct normal force
description: Essential: The response must state or calculate the normal force from the ground as 320 N.

title: Correct friction coefficient
description: Essential: The response must state or calculate the coefficient of kinetic friction as 0.25.

title: Vertical force equilibrium
description: Important: The solution must apply Newton's first law in the vertical direction, balancing forces including the vertical component of the applied force.

title: Horizontal force equilibrium
description: Important: The solution must apply Newton's first law in the horizontal direction, equating the horizontal component of the applied force to the kinetic friction.

title: Friction law application
description: Important: The solution must correctly apply the kinetic friction formula μ = f/N to find the coefficient.

title: Component resolution
description: Optional: The solution explicitly resolves the applied force into horizontal (Fcosθ) and vertical (Fsinθ) components.

title: Sign error in normal force
description: Pitfall: Incorrectly adding the vertical component of the applied force to the weight when calculating the normal force.

title: Unit omission or misuse
description: Pitfall: Presenting numerical answers without correct units (N for forces, dimensionless for μ) or using incorrect units.
